subject: Two-day close: commit audit, forecast tally, and account sweep
messages:
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Two-day close: commit audit, forecast tally, and account sweep

Morning team —

We’re entering the two-day window before quarter close. Please treat this as the authoritative call for final stage hygiene and commit validation for any deals that could fund this quarter. Key asks: 

- Fill the attached commit-rollup-template.xlsx with final ARR, expected PO/PO release date, and the concrete blocker (if any).
- Mark any deal where procurement or legal approval is pending and give the exact bottleneck owner.
- If you believe we should hold a reserve (credit) or an SLA exception for a particular account, flag it and cc Finance.

Specific notes: Acme Media (DL-2026-ACME-78) has an inbound procurement counterproposal — Sarah at Acme is on the thread. If Sales marks this as committed, Finance will need a final PO or a signed DocuSign by 10:00 AM PDT on Friday to count it in the quarter.

I'll run a short commit-audit meeting tomorrow 10:30 AM PT for any ambiguous items — invite will go out shortly. If you cannot make it, add your row to the spreadsheet with explicit next-step and owner.

Attachments: commit-rollup-template.xlsx (template)

Thanks —
David Kim
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: david_kim@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Two-day close: commit audit, forecast tally, and account sweep

Got it — thanks David. I reviewed the template and populated rows for our top 6 close candidates. Highlights:

- Acme Media: Sales view = "conditional commit" pending procurement countersign. I added expected doc timeline (Sarah H. said EOD Thurs for redlines; legal needs 24h after).
- Coastal Health: PO confirmed, finance pending invoice acceptance.
- Innovex (new): we’re routing for a small credit request; noted in comments.

I attached the completed sheet as "commit-rollup-template.xlsx" (v1). I also left a short comment on row 4 for Ben to clarify the commercial cadence.

Attachment: commit-rollup-template.xlsx (filled v1)

-Marissa

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, sarah.holt@acme-media.com
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 14:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Two-day close: commit audit, forecast tally, and account sweep

Quick clarification on Acme Media row: 

- Status: Sales has verbal alignment on pricing but procurement submitted a small change to our data-retention clause (section 5.2). That is the blocker; legal is already reviewing Acme's language.
- Ask: Can Finance confirm whether we should accept a 60-day invoice term versus our standard 30 days for this enterprise? If we accept 60, we need to log it as "payment-term variance" and consider it in revenue timing for close.

Sarah — if you can confirm when you expect to finalize redlines, that’ll help.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior AE, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@acme-media.com
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 17:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Two-day close: commit audit, forecast tally, and account sweep

Thanks everyone —

Finance review: per policy, a 60-day payment term is acceptable for recognition if we receive a signed PO before close and there is no material contingent condition. For Acme:

- If Acme provides a signed PO or a DocuSign agreement that contains the revised term by 10:00 AM PT Friday (2026-12-18), we will include the ARR in this quarter's forecast.
- If only redlines are circulating and no signed PO is received, count as "pending" for recognition — do not count the ARR.

I approved a one-off SLA exception form for Acme (see attached acme-sla-exception-request.pdf); this only covers our agreed uptime credit wording and does not affect revenue recognition.

Closing note: please ensure the commit-rollup-template.xlsx row for Acme has the exact PO number and the attached DocuSign id (or HubSpot deal link) if/when it arrives. I will audit the spreadsheet at 11:00 AM PT Friday and confirm final booking decisions.

Attachment: acme-sla-exception-request.pdf

Laura Bennett
Head of Revenue Operations & Finance Programs
Redwood Inference
